_about: Editable points data for BANDIT. Pendle publishes a points multiplier per YT (for example 20x Sats); BANDIT reads it live. There is no universal points API, so anything Pendle does not publish lives here. Never invent a rate: leave pointsPerDollarDay and basePointsPerDollarDay null when unknown, and BANDIT shows 'rate unknown' and keeps the market out of the cost ranking. status is one of: confirmed points, speculative airdrop, none known. guideUrl (optional) renders as 'Read the guide'.
unit: Pendle units: 1 pt is a 1x multiplier on $1 of underlying for 1 day. Set basePointsPerDollarDay for a program to convert to that program's real points.
